'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirteen people are killed, and several others are injured when a passenger bus overturns on a highway and collides with a [[taxi cab|taxi]] in [[Isfahan Province]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-bus-crash-isfahan-traffic-e28f553e0c9aa83d49dc9f15c639ca6a (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration]] records the [[Arctic]]'s [[Climate of the Arctic|warmest year]] since measurements began, with average temperatures from October 2024 to September 2025 standing 1.60 °C (2.88 °F) above [[Climatological normal|the 1991–2020 baseline]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20251216-arctic-sees-unprecedented-heat-as-climate-impacts-cascade (AFP via RFI)]

'''International relations'''

**[[Israel]] denies entry to six [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Member of Parliament (Canada)|MPs]] trying to visit the occupied [[West Bank]] as part of a nonprofit-sponsored tour. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/16/israel-denies-entry-to-canadian-mps-trying-to-reach-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Operation Southern Spear]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] orders a [[blockade]] on [[oil tanker]]s entering and leaving [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/us/news/2025/12/17/trump-orders-blockade-sanctioned-venezuela-oil-tankers/ (''The Telegraph'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Beninese coup attempt]]
**[[Benin]] places about 30 suspects, most of them [[Benin Armed Forces|soldiers]], in [[pre-trial detention]] on charges including [[treason]], [[Crime in Benin|murder]], and endangering [[National security|state security]] following a failed [[Coup d'état|coup]] attempt. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2626460/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*[[2025 Liverpool parade incident]]
**The [[Liverpool Crown Court]] convicts Paul Doyle, the perpetrator who injured 130 people after [[Vehicle-ramming attack|ramming his car]] into a crowd in [[Liverpool]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], of charges of [[dangerous driving]] and [[Non-fatal offences against the person in English law#Maliciously wounding or inflicting grievous bodily harm|maliciously]] causing [[grievous bodily harm]], and sentences him to 21 years in prison. [https://www.dw.com/en/uk-21-years-in-jail-for-liverpool-parade-car-rammer/a-75190950 (DW)]
*[[Belarus–Lithuania relations]]
**[[Lithuania]]n [[Lithuanian Police Force|police]] arrest 21 people allegedly connected to a criminal network responsible for [[Illicit cigarette trade|smuggling cigarettes]] into the country via [[weather balloon]]s from [[Belarus]]. [https://apnews.com/article/lithuania-balloons-belarus-arrests-052dffe4e6d5b5dffbc7faf1591dc9e1 (AP)]
*[[Colombia–United States relations]], [[War on drugs]]
**The [[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Department of State|State Department]] designates [[Colombia]]n [[Drug cartel|cartel]] and [[Right-wing paramilitarism in Colombia|neo-paramilitary]] group [[Clan del Golfo]] as a [[foreign terrorist organization]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-designates-colombias-largest-drug-gang-as-terror-group/a-75191506 (DW)]
